_comment: Model endpoint registry for the -execute derivation path. Copy to $MEMOIRE_HOME/model-endpoints.json (or point MEMOIRE_MODEL_ENDPOINTS at this file) and replace the placeholder with your OpenAI-compatible endpoint (llama.cpp, vLLM, Ollama, ...). api_key_env names the env var holding the bearer token; the value is NEVER stored here (env-var-by-name, see D73). Omit api_key_env for unauthenticated local endpoints. No hostnames are compiled into the binary; the copied registry file is their home.

endpoints._comment: OPTIONAL derive profile (docs/DERIVE-PROFILE-DESIGN.md): the endpoint's declared context geometry. Without it an endpoint behaves exactly as before — flags and built-in defaults. With it, the prompt ceiling is computed rather than shared across models: effective_max_prompt_bytes = floor((ctx_tokens - max_completion_tokens - margin_tokens) * bytes_per_token), so prompt + completion + margin always fits the serving context. bytes_per_token is MEASURED on your own content (~2.2-2.3 for session transcripts on Qwen tokenizers) — declare it conservatively; no tokenizer runs inside memoire. thinking DECLARES how the server is started (llama-server --reasoning / --reasoning-budget N); memoire records it in run provenance and never sends it to the model. An explicit -max-prompt-bytes / -max-completion-tokens still wins over the profile.
